title: map alone gives one array per order, not one flat list
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ((order) -> order.line_items map ((li) -> { orderId: order.order_id, sku: li.sku }))

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map ((order) -> order.line_items map ((li) -> { orderId: order.order_id, sku: li.sku }))

explanation.approach: Two orders in, two arrays out — nested one level too deep for a flat CSV, where every line item needs to be a sibling row, not tucked inside its parent's array.
